provenance.labels: Author-assigned: 2 direct answer, 1 supporting context, 0 unjudged/unrelated. No independent human review is claimed.
provenance.limitations: AI-authored English fixture, public paired-thread links and sparse pair judgements can favor relation expansion. No independent human review or production guarantee.
provenance.split_policy: v1 development retained; 24 newly authored families hash-ordered into 12 calibration and 12 test groups before encoding. No v1 calibration/test query reused.
